subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should a beta release be considered complete and publishable once core proof succeeds while plugin npm and ClawHub convergence continue asynchronously as a visible repairable state?
rationale: This PR intentionally changes beta release completion semantics and operational responsibility; correctness repairs alone cannot determine whether that policy is acceptable.

options.title: Adopt beta-live after repairs
options.body: Approve non-blocking plugin ecosystem convergence for prereleases once the three recovery and maturity-evidence defects are fixed, while retaining stable blocking behavior.

options.title: Keep ecosystem convergence blocking
options.body: Require beta publish to wait for plugin npm and ClawHub completion, retaining the present release-completion contract and using the new evidence only for diagnostics.

options.title: Require an explicit beta wait mode
options.body: Make asynchronous convergence opt-in for release operators rather than the default beta completion path.

recommendation.title: Adopt beta-live after repairs
recommendation.body: Approve non-blocking plugin ecosystem convergence for prereleases once the three recovery and maturity-evidence defects are fixed, while retaining stable blocking behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This group is the explicit environment approval boundary for npm release publication and is best positioned to choose the release-completion policy.
